scope: Preserve all four admitted Android archive profiles as provenance history and for local development. CI promotes and verifies only the release APK and AAB; debug/instrumentation APKs are no longer release candidates.
oracle: P2-017 narrows the promoted inventory to the existing release APK and AAB. All retained r5 resource, dependency, identity and exclusion rules remain byte-for-byte unchanged. Only the owned resource-verifier recipe changes to enumerate these two archives; no generated candidate establishes an expectation. Debug/test admissions remain recorded to preserve the existing provenance chain; their archives are not produced or promoted by the release candidate job.
